blurb: Guests explore the St. Louis brewery campus, visit the Budweiser Clydesdales, and taste beer from the finishing cellars. Tours include walking both inside and outside areas and are available year-round. Private event spaces are available with catering and brewery tours as add-ons.
extraNote: Tours run rain or shine; bring umbrella recommended · Bookings can be cancelled or rescheduled up to 24h before tour with 10% or $1 per person non-refundable fee · Walk-ins accommodated if space available; reservations strongly recommended · Tour center at 1200 Lynch St, St. Louis, MO 63118 · Year round
